newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Oil raises March wholesale product prices.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Oil raises March wholesale product prices.

text.p: Leading refiner Nippon Oil Co Ltd said on Friday it would raise the wholesale price for gasoline, gas oil and kerosene by 600 yen per kilolitre (kl) from March 1 after taking into account recent foreign exchange rates.
Following the increase, the wholesale price of the oil products will be priced at 39,200 yen per kl, excluding tax.
Nippon Oil said in a news release that it has decided to take the step because a weaker yen has made the purchase of crude oil more expensive despite a decline in world oil prices.
